chunks: Zurarah and Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام used to say: “Whoever recites behind an Imam whom he follows, then dies, will be resurrected upon other than the fiṭrah.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, a title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader who is being followed in congregational salat
key_terms.بُعِثَ: will be resurrected and raised on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.فِطْرَةٍ: the innate natural disposition upon truth and sound religion
key_terms.يَأْتَمُّ بِهِ: follows him as an Imam in prayer

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about reciting behind the Imam in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against reciting behind an Imam one is following in congregational salat. It presents the matter with severe language, linking such action to being raised on other than the sound fiṭrah, which indicates the gravity of opposing the proper manner of following the Imam in prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1156 – Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (as) used to say: "Whoever recites (aloud) behind an Imam whom he follows (in prayer) and then dies will be resurrected on a different (incorrect) natural disposition (fitra)."
